exact_pair_score.meaning: for a fixed pivot-involving v2 pair whose macro fits, rho equals exact post-macro raw cap slack for eliminating x

primary_objective.name: MAX_RHO
primary_objective.definition: max rho over every root pivot, both pivot polarities, and every repeated co-literal b
primary_objective.meaning: no pivot-involving v2 pair can return its own pivot below N^2

secondary_objectives: minimize number of nonnegative-rho pivot-involving pairs
maximize ordinary overflow once MAX_RHO ties

factorization_contract.E_same_block: generator-intersection resolvent classes x all opposite-block union classes
factorization_contract.E_cross_block: all leaf resolvent classes x opposite-block union classes whose generator intersection contains b
factorization_contract.H_same_block: exact star clause families factor into transformed pivot-leaf projections x unchanged opposite leaf
factorization_contract.H_cross_block: exact star clause families factor into pivot-leaf projections x b-conditioned/transformed opposite-leaf clauses
factorization_contract.selftest: representative same-block and cross-block rho values must equal full exact macro plus uncapped elimination replay on the frozen witness
